answer: Rhythmic Beacon Attestation. Each agent submits a continuous low-power work trace (the signal) tied to a random timing schedule; the network samples it against neighboring traces to form a shared nebula map of activity. Any duplicated identity can't fake independent timing without emitting correlated traces, which cluster visibly. Each sybil thus needs a distinct hardware timing source and idle compute budget (roughly one full node's idle cycles daily) or it collapses into the wharf of flagged clusters.
